description: The NASDAQ-100 ranked best to worst on the session: price, change and sector for every stock. Pass symbol to ask about ONE company instead, like AAPL or NVDA, and you get its price, its move on the session and where it ranks on the board today. Equities are market data: numbers follow the connected account.

fresh.description: Set true to ask for the live view of this one call, for 5 credits, where the connected account otherwise receives it an hour behind. Accepted and free where the account is already live. No effect without a key.

symbol.description: One or more NASDAQ-100 tickers, comma separated, like AAPL or AAPL,MSFT. Empty returns the whole ranked board.

name: get_nasdaq100
title: NASDAQ-100 board
